facts.fact: The head of the data protection authority presented the requirements of Law No. 2017-020 on personal data protection and said compliance with it had become necessary, per Ettayar.
facts.system: Law No. 2017-020 on personal data protection

facts.fact: The authority's head, Mohamed Lemine Ould Sidi, led a meeting with public bodies on compliance with the data protection law, per Ettayar.
The authority met the state digital agency and Mauritanian telecom company on compliance requirements and data localisation mechanisms, with no decision reported.
